legitimateExplanations.title: A newly registered company with no transport history bidding on freight.
legitimateExplanations.actually: A genuine new entrant, or a newly incorporated vehicle of an existing operator restructuring its business.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Verify operating authority directly with the issuing authority, confirm insurance with the insurer, and confirm that declared equipment exists and is registered to the entity. A real new entrant passes all three; a phantom fails at least one.

legitimateExplanations.title: A shared or serviced office address.
legitimateExplanations.actually: Small legitimate hauliers and freight agents commonly use serviced offices while operating from a separate yard.
legitimateExplanations.ruleOut: Ask for the operational depot or parking location separately from the registered address, and verify that it exists and is capable of holding the declared fleet.

countermeasures.text: Automatically flag a first-time counterparty bidding on a load above a defined value threshold for manual release.
Treat a non-contactable carrier holding loaded cargo as a theft in progress and escalate to law enforcement immediately rather than as a service failure.
